commands.name: Report Plunger Drive Parameter

params.name: Selector
params.description: Reports selected drive parameter (see the dilutor command set XP2000 / XP6000 / ZaapMotion).

commands.response: One value per installed dilutor, meaning per the dilutor command set
commands.note: Without a configured ZaapMotion dilutor RPP returns 28. EVOware uses RPP0 (plunger position) after every plunger move.

commands.name: Report Last Error Code of Dilutor
commands.response: Error codes of the last command to all dilutors, e.g. '5,7,7,7,7,7,0,0' = dilutor 1 not connected, 2-6 not initialized, 7-8 initialized
commands.note: Read this after return code 28 (subdevice error).

commands.name: Report Dilutor Drive Status

params.name: Selector
params.description: 0 = plunger drive status, 1 = valve drive status.

commands.response: Eight status characters (dilutor REE). Drives that are not installed show error 5 = 'E'.
commands.note: The table of contents OCR reads it as 'ROD'.
